Definition
[$S_k^+$ and $S_k^-$] ↗ def:shock-set ↗ def:admissible-pair-lax-entropy-condition 1. ch11:11.2-def-5\group Conservation Laws

If the pair $(\lambda _k, r_k)$ is genuinely nonlinear, we write \[ S_k^+(z_0) := \{ z\in S_k(z_0) \mid \lambda _k(z_0) < \sigma (z,z_0) < \lambda _k(z)\} \] and \[ S_k^-(z_0) := \{ z\in S_k(z_0) \mid \lambda _k(z) < \sigma (z,z_0) < \lambda _k(z_0)\} . \] Then \[ S_k(z_0) = S_k^+(z_0) \cup \{ z_0\} \cup S_k^-(z_0) \] near $z_0$. Note then that the pair $(u_l, u_r)$ is admissible if and only if \[ u_r \in S_k^-(u_l). \]
